description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for managing insurance claims, including CRUD operations and claim listing with sorting. It also interacts with claims storage and a fraud engine for scoring.

methods.name: GET /claims
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of claims based on fraud score and submission date.

methods.name: POST /claims
methods.description: Creates a new claim, applies fraud scoring, and stores it.

methods.name: GET /claims/{id}
methods.description: Retrieves a specific claim by its ID.

methods.name: PUT /claims/{id}
methods.description: Updates an existing claim and re-applies fraud scoring.

methods.name: DELETE /claims/{id}
methods.description: Deletes a claim by its ID.
